stances.intent: Pitch the head down, then back to the look-ahead pose. Legs stay a stand.
Lift the arm end a little, yaw left and right twice, then back. Legs stay a stand.
Arm up, the gripper opens and closes twice, then the arm returns to the look-ahead stand.
Rise on the legs, then back down.

ready.intent: Head level, looking straight ahead. Legs stay a stand.
